Added a dated NOTES.md 2026-08-11 (fix pass) section explaining the status-label tension, the fix, and citing the source URLs (LPM article, louisvilledatacenter.com, PowerHouse news page).
remaining_risks: The inventory issue string itself is truncated (ends mid-phrase "conflicts with the co..."); the fix was applied per brief type-1 guidance (status/evidence mismatch) using the entry's contradictions[1] and NOTES.md as the referenced conflict.

No official building permit, construction start, energization, or operational evidence was found (unchanged by this fix); status remains qualified accordingly and does not upgrade to site work-construction.
This disc entry has no top-level `verified` flag; the canonical disc schema in the brief does not require one and the issue did not raise it, so none was added.
